name: arxiv-triage
description: Overlay for arXiv listing pages that scores, triages and learns which papers you care about.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test
scripts.build:e2e:firefox: cross-env E2E=1 wxt build -b firefox --mv3 && cross-env E2E=1 E2E_REAL_MODEL=1 wxt build -b firefox --mv3
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build:e2e:firefox && cross-env SE_CACHE_PATH=.cache/selenium vitest run --config vitest.firefox.config.ts
